panels.title: Execution success

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Executions that published a finish among all executions over fifteen minutes. Requests where no receipt was expected are not counted.

panels.title: Acquire errors

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Times per minute a host could not acquire an ML node for a call. Such calls never reach a model.

panels.title: Validation success

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Validations that finished ok among those that finished ok or with an error over fifteen minutes. Deferred validations are not counted.

panels.title: Peers not ready
panels.description: Peer sessions that are attaching or unauthenticated. Zero when every peer session is ready.

panels.title: DevShard hosts
panels.description: One row per host: scrape state, finished inferences and execution success, ML node acquire errors and call p95, work in flight, live inferences, owed validations, ready peer sessions, process memory and the Postgres pool.

panels.title: Inferences finished per minute

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Inferences each host finished and published, per minute.

panels.title: Execution success

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Share of executions that published a finish on each host over fifteen minutes. The dashed line is 98 percent.

panels.title: Requests without a finish

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Requests that ended without a published finish, per minute and reason, over the selected hosts. payload_absent and target_diff_absent expect no receipt; acquire_err, process_response_err, http_5xx and transport_err are executions that failed.

panels.title: ML node call failures

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Calls from a host to its ML nodes that did not succeed, per minute. acquire_err means the host could not acquire an ML node for the call.

panels.title: ML node call p95

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: 95th percentile duration of a call from a host to its ML node over five minutes.

panels.title: Completion tokens per second

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Tokens the ML nodes of each host generated per second.

panels.title: Validation outcomes per minute

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Finished validations per minute by status over the selected hosts. deferred is a validation postponed to a later attempt.

panels.title: Validation queue

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Validations queued and owed by each host across its escrows. Owed validations that keep growing are work the host falls behind on.

panels.title: Validation executor faults

defaults.noValue: no DevShard host metrics are scraped

panels.description: Validations the executor could not run, per minute and reason.

panels.title: Live inferences

panels.description: Inferences each host keeps in memory across its DevShard sessions. A count that keeps rising under steady load is retained state.

panels.title: Executing and validating

panels.title: Process memory

panels.title: Sessions
